description: Zero automatic milestones from iterations; one new capability candidate; replay adds none. Repeated step IDs represent additional runs of the same assessed type, not extra expected cases.
review_note: The new aggregate packet contributes already recorded subordinate IDs. Its own post-publication replay reuses DSP-AGGREGATE. Only the aggregate acceptance creates a new recommendation; existing events are not duplicated.

description: Replays do not reverse dispositions or mistake pending for applied.
review_note: Same NO_CHRONICLE_UPDATE label has distinct reuse/reconciliation obligations; never create a fresh no_update to replace defer, reject, or author.

description: Evidence and context changes independently permit linked new assessments.
review_note: Significance comes from source content and changed consequence; digests only bind persisted bytes.
